name: hm-token-intelligence
description: Prompt intelligence and token-efficiency assistant with an MCP-ready exact tokenizer workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze prompts and measure token efficiency.
interface.longDescription: HM reviews prompt clarity and quality, identifies waste and ambiguity, proposes intent-preserving improvements, and compares exact token counts when the HM Token Engine MCP tools are connected.
capabilities: Improve prompt quality while preserving intent
Count tokens with supported encodings when connected
Compare original and revised prompt token counts
Evaluate AI answers against original requirements
